name: A quiet clock opens before dawn
looks: A plain digital clock reading an early morning hour sits alone with a single faint glowing dot above it; a quiet line of type fades in underneath naming the stillness of the hour, the whole frame calm and almost empty.
build: The clock and dot are static; the caption line fades in alone (`opacity 0 -> 1`, ~400ms, slow) well after the clock settles, with no other motion in the frame to compete with it.
sound: Near silence, a single soft ambient tone under the caption's fade.
prompt: Open on a plain early-morning clock reading alone in an empty, dark frame, with a single faint glowing accent dot above it, and let one quiet line of type fade in beneath it well after the clock settles, establishing a calm, private moment before anything happens.
